english: I opened the window in the morning.
chinese: 我早上打开了窗户。
translated_english: This morning, I opened the window.

english: She washed her cup after breakfast.
chinese: 她吃完早饭后洗了杯子。
translated_english: After finishing breakfast, she cleaned her cup.

english: He put his keys on the table.
chinese: 他把钥匙放在桌上。
translated_english: He set the keys down on the table.

english: I walked to the store nearby.
chinese: 我走路去了附近的商店。
translated_english: I went on foot to a nearby shop.

english: They cleaned the room together.
chinese: 他们一起打扫了房间。
translated_english: They tidied the room together.

english: The bag is under the chair.
chinese: 包在椅子下面。
translated_english: The bag sits beneath the chair.

english: This notebook has a blue cover.
chinese: 这个笔记本是蓝色封面的。
translated_english: This notebook comes with a blue cover.

english: The phone battery is low.
chinese: 手机快没电了。
translated_english: The phone is nearly out of power.

english: There is a bottle on the desk.
chinese: 桌上有一个瓶子。
translated_english: A bottle is sitting on the table.

english: My jacket is in the closet.
chinese: 我的外套在衣柜里。
translated_english: My coat is inside the wardrobe.

english: I felt tired after class.
chinese: 下课后我觉得很累。
translated_english: After class, I felt very worn out.

english: She was happy about the result.
chinese: 她对这个结果很开心。
translated_english: She felt pleased with this result.

english: He felt nervous before the meeting.
chinese: 开会前他有点紧张。
translated_english: Before the meeting, he was somewhat anxious.

english: I was surprised by the message.
chinese: 这条消息让我有些意外。
translated_english: This message caught me a bit off guard.

english: They felt relaxed on the weekend.
chinese: 周末他们感觉很放松。
translated_english: On the weekend, they felt quite at ease.

english: I reviewed my notes before the quiz.
chinese: 测验前我复习了笔记。
translated_english: Before the test, I went over my notes.

english: The teacher explained the problem clearly.
chinese: 老师把这道题讲得很清楚。
translated_english: The teacher explained this question very clearly.

english: She borrowed a book from the library.
chinese: 她从图书馆借了一本书。
translated_english: She checked out a book from the library.

english: We discussed the project after class.
chinese: 我们下课后讨论了项目。
translated_english: After class, we talked over the project.

english: He submitted the assignment online.
chinese: 他在网上提交了作业。
translated_english: He turned in the homework online.

english: I sent the report before noon.
chinese: 我中午前发出了报告。
translated_english: I sent off the report before noon.

english: She joined the meeting on time.
chinese: 她准时参加了会议。
translated_english: She was present at the meeting right on time.

english: He checked the email during lunch.
chinese: 他午饭时看了邮件。
translated_english: He looked at his email during lunch.

english: The team finished the task today.
chinese: 团队今天完成了任务。
translated_english: The team got the task done today.

english: I made a short plan for tomorrow.
chinese: 我简单安排了明天的计划。
translated_english: I briefly arranged tomorrow's plan.

english: It rained for most of the afternoon.
chinese: 下午大部分时间都在下雨。
translated_english: It was raining for most of the afternoon.

english: The sky was clear this morning.
chinese: 今天早上天空很晴朗。
translated_english: The sky looked very clear this morning.

english: The wind became stronger at night.
chinese: 晚上风变大了。
translated_english: The wind picked up in the evening.

english: It was warm outside after lunch.
chinese: 午饭后外面很暖和。
translated_english: It felt warm outside after lunch.

english: The snow covered the street.
chinese: 雪盖住了街道。
translated_english: The street was covered with snow.

english: The cafe is next to the station.
chinese: 咖啡馆就在车站旁边。
translated_english: The cafe is right beside the station.

english: The classroom is on the third floor.
chinese: 教室在三楼。
translated_english: The classroom is located on the third floor.

english: The park is quiet in the morning.
chinese: 早上的公园很安静。
translated_english: In the morning, the park is very quiet.

english: The office is across from the bank.
chinese: 办公室在银行对面。
translated_english: The office is opposite the bank.

english: The bus stop is near my apartment.
chinese: 公交站离我公寓很近。
translated_english: The bus stop is very near my apartment.

english: I ate soup for dinner.
chinese: 我晚饭喝了汤。
translated_english: I had soup with dinner.

english: She bought fresh fruit after work.
chinese: 她下班后买了新鲜水果。
translated_english: After work, she bought some fresh fruit.

english: He made coffee before studying.
chinese: 他学习前泡了咖啡。
translated_english: Before studying, he brewed some coffee.

english: We shared a small cake.
chinese: 我们分着吃了一个小蛋糕。
translated_english: We split a small cake between us.

english: The noodles were too hot to eat.
chinese: 面条太烫了没法马上吃。
translated_english: The noodles were too hot to eat immediately.

english: I woke up at seven today.
chinese: 我今天七点醒了。
translated_english: Today, I woke up at seven.

english: The train arrived ten minutes late.
chinese: 火车晚到了十分钟。
translated_english: The train was ten minutes late arriving.

english: She waited for half an hour.
chinese: 她等了半个小时。
translated_english: She waited for thirty minutes.

english: The movie starts at eight.
chinese: 电影八点开始。
translated_english: The film begins at eight.

english: We finished before sunset.
chinese: 我们在日落前完成了。
translated_english: We got it done before sunset.

english: I called my friend after dinner.
chinese: 我晚饭后给朋友打了电话。
translated_english: After dinner, I phoned a friend.

english: She replied to the message quickly.
chinese: 她很快回复了消息。
translated_english: She answered the message very quickly.

english: He asked a question in class.
chinese: 他在课上问了一个问题。
translated_english: He raised a question during class.

english: We talked about the weekend plan.
chinese: 我们聊了周末的计划。
translated_english: We chatted about our weekend plans.

english: I wrote a short email to my teacher.
chinese: 我给老师写了一封简短的邮件。
translated_english: I wrote the teacher a brief email.

english: Families often reunite during the Spring Festival.
chinese: 春节时家人常常团聚。
translated_english: At Spring Festival, family members often get together.

english: People watch lanterns during the Lantern Festival.
chinese: 元宵节时人们会看花灯。
translated_english: During the Lantern Festival, people go to see lantern displays.

english: Mooncakes are shared during the Mid-Autumn Festival.
chinese: 中秋节时大家会分享月饼。
translated_english: At Mid-Autumn Festival, people share mooncakes.

english: People eat zongzi during the Dragon Boat Festival.
chinese: 端午节时人们会吃粽子。
translated_english: During Dragon Boat Festival, people usually eat zongzi.

english: A reunion dinner is important on New Year's Eve.
chinese: 除夕夜的团圆饭很重要。
translated_english: The reunion meal on New Year's Eve matters a lot.

english: Respecting elders is seen as important in many families.
chinese: 很多家庭都很重视尊敬长辈。
translated_english: Many families place great importance on respecting older relatives.

english: Parents often worry about their children's future.
chinese: 父母常常会操心孩子的未来。
translated_english: Parents often concern themselves with their children's future.

english: The whole family discussed the decision together.
chinese: 全家人一起商量了这个决定。
translated_english: The whole family talked over this decision together.

english: He brought gifts when visiting his relatives.
chinese: 他去看亲戚时带了礼物。
translated_english: When he visited relatives, he brought gifts.

english: She called home before the holiday.
chinese: 放假前她给家里打了电话。
translated_english: Before the break, she called her family at home.

english: Red is often used for happy occasions in China.
chinese: 在中国红色常用于喜庆场合。
translated_english: In China, red is often used for joyful occasions.

english: Gold often suggests wealth and good wishes.
chinese: 金色常让人想到财富和祝福。
translated_english: Gold often brings wealth and blessings to mind.

english: White flowers can feel solemn in some Chinese settings.
chinese: 在一些中文语境里白花会显得比较庄重。
translated_english: In some Chinese-language contexts, white flowers can seem rather solemn.

english: Bright red decorations made the room feel festive.
chinese: 鲜红的装饰让房间很有节日气氛。
translated_english: The bright red decorations gave the room a holiday mood.

english: The red envelope carried a wish for good luck.
chinese: 红包里包含着好运的祝福。
translated_english: A red envelope contains wishes for good fortune.

english: Saving face can matter in a difficult conversation.
chinese: 在难聊的事情里给对方面子可能很重要。
translated_english: When a topic is hard to discuss, giving the other person face may matter.

english: People may speak indirectly to avoid embarrassment.
chinese: 人们有时会说得委婉些以免尴尬。
translated_english: Sometimes people speak more indirectly to avoid awkwardness.

english: Guests are often offered tea when they arrive.
chinese: 客人到了以后常会被招呼喝茶。
translated_english: After guests arrive, they are often invited to have tea.

english: It is polite to thank the host after a meal.
chinese: 饭后感谢主人是有礼貌的。
translated_english: Thanking the host after a meal shows good manners.

english: Some families ask guests to remove shoes at the door.
chinese: 有些家庭会请客人在门口换鞋。
translated_english: Some households ask guests to change shoes at the entrance.

english: Red envelopes are given during the Spring Festival.
chinese: 春节时人们会发红包。
translated_english: During Spring Festival, people give out red envelopes.

english: People paste spring couplets on the door.
chinese: 人们会把春联贴在门上。
translated_english: People put Spring Festival couplets on their doors.

english: Firecrackers are linked with New Year celebrations.
chinese: 鞭炮常和过年庆祝联系在一起。
translated_english: Firecrackers are often associated with celebrating the New Year.

english: Tea can be served to show respect.
chinese: 敬茶可以表达尊重。
translated_english: Offering tea can be a way to show respect.

english: Calligraphy is often displayed during festivals.
chinese: 节日期间常能看到书法作品。
translated_english: During festivals, calligraphy pieces can often be seen.

english: The dragon often symbolizes strength in Chinese culture.
chinese: 龙在中国文化里常象征力量。
translated_english: In Chinese culture, the dragon often stands for strength.

english: The panda is often seen as gentle and friendly.
chinese: 熊猫常被看作温和友好的象征。
translated_english: Pandas are often viewed as symbols of gentleness and friendliness.

english: Bamboo can suggest resilience and modesty.
chinese: 竹子可以让人想到坚韧和谦逊。
translated_english: Bamboo can call to mind toughness and humility.

english: The moon often suggests reunion in Chinese poems.
chinese: 月亮在中文诗歌里常让人想到团圆。
translated_english: In Chinese poetry, the moon often evokes reunion.

english: The plum blossom can suggest strength in winter.
chinese: 梅花可以象征寒冬中的坚强。
translated_english: Plum blossoms can represent strength in the cold of winter.

english: He finally understood the problem.
chinese: 他终于恍然大悟了。
translated_english: He finally realized it all at once.

english: This plan solves two problems at once.
chinese: 这个办法一举两得。
translated_english: This approach gets two benefits with one move.

english: A bad thing may lead to a good result.
chinese: 塞翁失马焉知非福。
translated_english: A loss may turn out not to be bad after all.

english: Do not give up when things get hard.
chinese: 遇到困难也不要轻易放弃。
translated_english: Even when facing difficulty, do not give up too easily.

english: He worked hard after a late start.
chinese: 他起步晚但后来很努力。
translated_english: He started later than others, but worked hard afterward.

english: Giving a clock can feel inappropriate in Chinese culture.
chinese: 在中国文化里送钟可能不太合适。
translated_english: In Chinese culture, giving a clock may feel unsuitable.

english: Fruit baskets are common gifts for visits.
chinese: 探望别人时水果篮是常见礼物。
translated_english: When visiting someone, a fruit basket is a common gift.

english: A gift is often accepted with modest words.
chinese: 收礼时人们常会客气几句。
translated_english: When accepting a gift, people often say a few polite modest words.

english: The wrapping can matter as much as the gift.
chinese: 礼物的包装有时也很重要。
translated_english: Sometimes the way a gift is wrapped also matters.

english: Small gifts can show care during a visit.
chinese: 拜访时带点小礼物能表达心意。
translated_english: Bringing a small gift on a visit can show thoughtfulness.

english: The number eight is often linked with good luck.
chinese: 数字八常和好运联系在一起。
translated_english: The number eight is often tied to good luck.

english: Some people choose lucky numbers for phone numbers.
chinese: 有些人会给手机号选吉利数字。
translated_english: Some people choose auspicious numbers for their phone number.

english: Double numbers can feel neat and lucky.
chinese: 叠在一起的数字常显得顺眼又吉利。
translated_english: Repeated numbers often look pleasing and feel lucky.

english: A lucky date can make an event feel special.
chinese: 选个好日子会让事情显得更有意义。
translated_english: Picking an auspicious day can make an event feel more meaningful.

english: Numbers can carry extra meaning beyond counting.
chinese: 数字有时不只是用来计数。
translated_english: Sometimes numbers are used for more than just counting.

english: Sharing dishes is common at many Chinese meals.
chinese: 很多中餐场合会大家一起夹菜分享。
translated_english: At many Chinese meals, everyone shares dishes together.

english: Noodles can symbolize long life on birthdays.
chinese: 生日吃面有时象征长寿。
translated_english: Eating noodles on a birthday can symbolize long life.

english: Dumplings are often eaten during New Year celebrations.
chinese: 过年时人们常吃饺子。
translated_english: People often eat dumplings when celebrating the New Year.

english: Tea can be part of both daily life and ceremony.
chinese: 茶既可以是日常饮品也可以有仪式感。
translated_english: Tea can be an everyday drink and also carry a sense of ritual.

english: A full table can show warmth and hospitality.
chinese: 一桌丰盛的饭菜能表达热情好客。
translated_english: A table full of food can show warmth and hospitality.
